changes.before: To mention a teammate use the @ symbol with their username in the comments or description section. They'll get a Direct Message notification via Channels and also be added as a [follower](https://docs.{old company name}.com/boards/work-with-cards.html#receive-updates) to the card.

reviewNotes.text: Cards can be linked and shared with teammates directly on Channels. Card previews are displayed when shared on Channels, so your team can discuss work items and get the relevant context without having to switch over to fvoci.
After you've copied the link, paste it into any channel or Direct Message to share the card. A preview of the card will display within the channel with a link back to the card on fvoci.
Whenever any changes are made to the card, they'll automatically get notified on Channels.
